name: RuneScapeX
short: Detailed RuneScape 3 and OSRS public hiscores, PvM, clues, and OSRS GE data.
description: A non-conflicting companion for existing RuneScape cogs. Public Jagex hiscores and OSRS Wiki real-time Grand Exchange API, persistent gain snapshots, skills, bosses, clues, comparisons, and item search. No API key required.
author: ill-will-iam
install_msg: Load with [p]load runescapex, then use [p]rsx. This installs alongside your existing runescape cog without replacing it.
